result.reason: The clause omits an express prohibition on direct access to Customer systems and leaves the original audit language in place, creating conflicts over auditor eligibility and scope: the new language limits audits to an independent CPA and fee-relevant records, while subsection (b) permits other audit professionals to assess compliance with all terms. It also goes beyond the playbook by adding a 24-month look-back, a contingent-fee restriction, and overpayment refunds with interest. The duplicative, inconsistent structure is not professionally drafted and alters commercial terms beyond what is necessary.
